title: Two payment requests for the same invoice can both be created AND approved, together exceeding its balance — and the product's own pre-approval check calls the second one a match for the open balance
evidence: out/money-actions/double.json. Invoice 509 (f4000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000013, תבליני הגליל) had balance 640.00 ILS and request #16 for 300.00 ILS already in status `approved` and unexecuted. create_payment_request for 640.00 on the SAME invoice returned HTTP 200 {"amount":640,"number":18,"status":"pending_approval"}. payment_request_financial_check_signals for that request then returned {"amount_matches_open_balance": true, "over_allocated_invoice_count": 0}. transition_payment_request to `approved` returned HTTP 200 {"status":"approved"}. Two approved transfers totalling 940.00 ILS stood against a 640.00 ILS invoice. Earlier the same run (out/money-actions/flow1 + state-after-flow1.json) a 640.00 request (#17) was accepted while #16 was still `pending_approval`. Both probes were cancelled within seconds of measurement. Cause (code): create_payment_request (0023:598, patched by 0073:454) computes the balance as total_amount − payment_allocations − offset/closed credits; it never counts amounts already committed by live payment requests. p2_active_payment_request_total_by_currency exists but is a signal, not a guard.
repro: Sign in as owner → /payment-requests → create a request for part of an open invoice and approve it → create a second request on the same invoice for the whole balance → approve it too. Both sit in /pay.
expected: The second request is refused, or at minimum the approval is blocked and the check reports the over-commitment. The check's own field name, `amount_matches_open_balance`, must not be true when 940 is committed against 640.
actual: Both are created and approved and both reach the accountant's execution queue. execute_payment_request would refuse the second one — but only AFTER the accountant has made the transfer at the bank, because /pay's stated job is to RECORD a transfer already made ('הכפתור בתחתית המסך מתעד העברה שכבר בוצעה בבנק'). This is the exact shape of the open high-severity duplicate-payment exception this tenant already carries.

title: The open balance the product prints on invoice 3377 cannot be paid: requesting exactly the printed 150.00 is refused server-side, and the refusal tells the user to refresh a number that will never change
evidence: out/money-actions/overalloc-result.json. Reader: invoice_balances_by_currency for f4000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000014 returns {"total_amount":900,"paid_amount":750,"credited_amount":0,"balance_in_currency":150}; out/money-actions/55-invoices-list-final.png shows the row '3377 · אריזות הדרום · ₪900.00 · ₪150.00 · שולמה חלקית'; the supplier card (80-finsup-accountant.png) shows 'יתרה פתוחה 150 ₪'. Writer: create_payment_request with p_allocations [{invoice 3377, amount 150}] → HTTP 400, code P0001, message `payment_request_allocation_invalid`. The toast rendered for that code is 'הסכום שהוקצה גבוה מהיתרה הפתוחה. רענן את הנתונים ועדכן את החלוקה.' Cause (code): migration 0173 moved the READER (p0_invoice_balance_rows) and execute_payment_request onto payment_allocations carrying credit_id, but create_payment_request still subtracts `credit_requests where invoice_id = i.id and status in ('offset','closed')`. Credit #4 (150.00, status `offset`, no allocation row — pre-0173 data) therefore reduces the writer's balance to 0 while contributing 0 to the reader's. I RE-TESTED the offset path with a credit I created myself (see the verified list): a fresh credit offsets correctly and moves the balance exactly, so this is an un-migrated writer plus one stale row, not a broken offset path. Migration 0304 is titled 'the writer and the reader answer the same question' and fixed exactly this class — for payment_status only.
repro: Sign in as owner → /invoices → read '150.00 ₪' in the יתרה column of invoice 3377 → /payment-requests → new request → אריזות הדרום → tick invoice 3377, leave the suggested 150.00 → שליחה לאישור.
expected: Any amount the product prints as the open balance can be requested, or the printed balance is corrected. One of the two numbers is wrong and the user is told which.
actual: The screen offers 150.00 as the amount to pay, the server refuses it as an over-allocation, and the message asks the user to refresh — which redisplays 150.00. 150 ILS is unclaimable through the product and there is no screen that says so. This is the actionable half of FIN-02.

title: FIN-04 severity raised and cause inverted: the '$ 0' is not a phantom row on a supplier with no dollar activity — the supplier owes $300 and the accountant's screen prints zero
evidence: out/money-actions/final.json. As ACCOUNTANT, supplier_balances_by_currency for aa000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000013 (אריזות הדרום) returns [{ILS, 150, 1 open invoice}, {USD, 0, 0 open invoices}] and out/money-actions/80-finsup-accountant.png (read with the Read tool) shows 'יתרה פתוחה: 150 ₪ / 0 $'. As OWNER, the same function on the same supplier returns [{ILS, 150, 1}, {USD, 300, 1}]. Invoice QA-USD-001 (89ae89a4-8481-49f8-bb8a-1b0742c27722, 300.00 USD, unpaid, review_status `received`) is real and open. Cause (code): p0_supplier_balance_rows_by_currency (0218) builds the currency row from EVERY non-deleted payable invoice, then left-joins balances from p0_invoice_balance_rows_by_currency(), whose accountant arm filters to review_status = 'approved'; the missing balance becomes coalesce(...,0). The banner one line below the tile states the product's own rule: 'אין במערכת מועדי פירעון … לכן מוצג — ולא אפס.'
repro: Sign in as accountant → /finance/suppliers/aa000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000013 → read 'יתרה פתוחה'. Repeat as owner and compare.
expected: A currency the role cannot compute shows —, never 0. Zero is a claim that nothing is owed.
actual: The screen that owns a supplier's per-currency financial position tells the accountant the dollar exposure is zero while it is $300. FIN-04 reported this as a phantom row on a supplier with no dollar activity; that diagnosis is wrong and the severity is higher than medium.

title: One 2,950.00 ILS statement line carries two confirmed allocations of 2,950.00 each to the same invoice — 200% of the line, in production, and no screen shows it
evidence: out/money-actions/recon-owner.json, bank_allocations rows 79c9a835… aside, the two rows aefd9d49-6136-4990-8686-a3c084efb395 and 358c95e8-c1d3-4e53-b0b5-5097cdd84a49 both name bank_transaction fa000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000008 (2,950.00 ILS, 14.07.2026, דגי הים התיכון), both name invoice f4000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011 (6633), both amount 2950, both payment_id null (i.e. two DIRECT matches). The same invoice separately carries payment_allocation 3a19a94a… of 2,950 from payment 4adb4f3f. supabase/tests/p1_preflight.sql:73 already contains an `overallocated_bank_transactions` query that would name this row; the SQL suite runs against an isolated Supabase in CI, never against production. I could NOT reproduce the write: re-matching a matched line returns `bank_transaction_already_matched` or an idempotent 200 (out/money-actions/bank2.json), so this is existing damage rather than a currently reachable defect — most likely residue from the QA agent named in migration 0292's header, which records invoice 6633 as the one unapproved settlement it created.
repro: Sign in as owner → read bank_allocations for bank transaction fa000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000008; or /bank → the 14.07.2026 line for דגי הים התיכון.
expected: The sum of a statement line's confirmed allocations never exceeds the line, and a preflight check that already knows how to find this runs somewhere that can see production.
actual: 5,900.00 allocated from a 2,950.00 line, invisible on every screen, and the only query that detects it never looks at production.

title: FIN-10 confirmed by action and raised to medium: the red block says the transfer cannot be performed, and I performed it twice on that same card
evidence: out/money-actions/pay-card-galil.txt: my own card (תבליני הגליל, a supplier with no stored bank details) carries 'לא הוזנו פרטי בנק לספק זה, ולכן לא ניתן לבצע את ההעברה. יש לפנות לבעלים או למנהל הרכש … אין במסך זה דרך לדווח על כך.' immediately followed by 'הכפתור בתחתית המסך מתעד העברה שכבר בוצעה בבנק — הוא אינו מבצע אותה.' I pressed 'ההעברה בוצעה' twice on that card across two runs and both recordings succeeded: payments a3785e05-4783-4300-8fdb-a50fc436bbf7 (300.00, ref QA16-916560) and 95ff0a6d-837a-426e-b0bb-9ca385f01273 (300.00, ref QA19-602625), out/money-actions/pay-after-execute.txt ('ההעברה נרשמה') and 53-pay-executed-2.png.
repro: Sign in as accountant → /pay → open any card for a supplier with no stored bank details → read the red block → fill אסמכתת העברה → press ההעברה בוצעה.
expected: A screen whose job is recording a transfer already made does not open with a red block saying the transfer cannot be made. Missing bank details are a note about the NEXT transfer, not a refusal of this recording.
actual: The screen tells the accountant the action is impossible and the action then succeeds. FIN-10 recorded this as a wording contradiction (low); with the action performed it is a screen that discourages a legitimate, successful money recording, on every card in the queue.

title: FIN-01's mechanism, measured: the accountant can see only credits attached to an APPROVED invoice — 2 of the tenant's 11 — so the queue card can name 50.00 ILS of credits the same screen is structurally unable to show
evidence: out/money-actions/mechanism.json. As OWNER, credit_request_balance_rows for חוות השדה returns credit #8 (50.00 ILS, status `received`, invoice f4000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000012 = invoice 1509) and credit #10 (37.00 ILS, `open`, same invoice); the owner's credit_requests list returns 11 rows. As ACCOUNTANT the same table returns exactly 2 rows — #4 and #12 — the only two whose invoices are review_status `approved`; invoice 1509 is `received`. The /pay card for חוות השדה reads 'אושר בחריגה ללא קיזוז זיכויים בסך 50.00 ₪' (out/money-actions/pay-queue.txt) — that is credit #8. The approval-time total comes from payment_request_financial_check_signals (SECURITY DEFINER, sees every credit); the execution dialog reads credit_request_balance_rows (SECURITY INVOKER, under the accountant's RLS). The two answer the same question through different visibility by construction. Confirmed in the opposite direction: the credit I created on APPROVED invoice 509 appeared for the accountant in the same dialog and was offsettable (out/money-actions/52-pay-card-340-filled.png).
repro: Sign in as accountant → /pay → read the חוות השדה card's orange line → open it and read 'אין זיכויים פתוחים לספק זה' → /credits?status=all shows two credits in the whole tenant. Repeat as owner: eleven.
expected: One answer to 'does this supplier have open credits'. If the accountant may not see a credit, the queue card must not quote its amount.
actual: The card quotes an amount from a definer function and the dialog under it reads through RLS that hides the row. FIN-01 reported the contradiction; this is why it happens, and it will recur for every credit whose invoice is not yet approved.

title: The only consolidated-invoice case in the tenant has had its page uploaded for ~24 hours and still reads 'awaiting recognition · awaiting scan' — every figure is —, and all three reconciliation channels are empty
evidence: out/money-actions/consolidated.txt (case list: 'אריזות הדרום · אוגוסט 2026 · ממתינה לחשבונית מרכזת · 0 אזהרות · עדכון 03.09.2026, 00:43') and out/money-actions/consolidated-case.txt + 82-consolidated-case.png: 'עמוד 1 · consolidated-page-1.png', 'עוגן החשבונית · ממתין לזיהוי · ממתין לסריקה', 'סכום העוגן —', 'חשבוניות ביניים —', 'קבלות שהושלמו —', and 'אין שורות בערוץ התאמה זה' in all three channels. Measured at 04.09.2026 ~01:30 Israel time, i.e. about 24h after the last update.
repro: Sign in as owner → /documents/consolidated-invoices → open the אריזות הדרום · אוגוסט 2026 case.
expected: A page uploaded a day ago has been read, or the screen says what is stuck and what to do. 'ממתין לסריקה' names a state, not an instruction.
actual: One case, one page, zero output, no error and no elapsed-time signal. I did NOT upload a new consolidated invoice — uploads cost real money and the document pipeline belongs to the documents agent — so I cannot say whether a fresh intake would move; this is the state I found and it is the same 'every step succeeded, yield zero' shape the brief names.

title: FIN-08's open question answered: the server DOES enforce the un-match reason; the client's placeholder is what defeats the asterisk
evidence: out/money-actions/bank2.json: unmatch_bank_transaction with p_reason '   ' → HTTP 400, code 22023, message `bank_unmatch_invalid`. out/money-actions/bank3.json: the same call with a typed reason → 200, and audit_logs for the transaction carries action `bank_match_removed` with reason 'QA money-actions: reversing the reconciliation I created for this test'. So src/lib/reason.ts's reasonOr() placeholder is the only thing standing between an empty box and the server's own refusal — the label's '*' is honoured one layer down and hidden one layer up.
repro: Call rpc/unmatch_bank_transaction with a blank p_reason from an authenticated accountant session, then with a typed one, and read audit_logs for the transaction.
expected: The client either blocks the empty box (matching the server) or drops the asterisk (matching the match dialog beside it).
actual: The server refuses a blank reason by name; the client silently substitutes '<action> — ללא הערה מהמשתמש' so that refusal is never reached and the audit line records a tautology. Severity unchanged from FIN-08; only the unverified half is now measured.

title: FIN-09 confirmed from the action side: I drove an invoice to a MEASURED 0.00 and the list renders it as '—', identical to a balance that failed to load
evidence: I paid invoice 509 down to exactly zero (invoice_balances_by_currency: {total 640, paid 600, credited 40, balance 0}, out/money-actions/pay2.json). out/money-actions/inv509-final-detail.txt: the card reads 'שולם ‏600.00 ‏₪ · זוכה ‏40.00 ‏₪ · יתרה לתשלום ‏0.00 ‏₪'. out/money-actions/invoices-list-final.txt and 55-invoices-list-final.png (read with the Read tool): the same invoice's יתרה column reads '—', the same glyph as the eight other rows.
repro: Pay any invoice to exactly zero, then compare its row in /invoices with its detail card.
expected: A measured 0.00 is data. Either the list prints 0.00 or the two surfaces agree.
actual: Confirmed exactly as FIN-09 described, now with an invoice whose zero I produced myself. Severity unchanged.

title: The credit amount field is labelled 'סכום (₪) (ILS)' — the currency is printed twice, once as a symbol and once as a code
evidence: out/money-actions/31-credit-modal.png (read with the Read tool) and out/money-actions/credit-modal.txt: the label above the amount input reads 'סכום (₪) (ILS)'. Code: src/pages/InvoiceDetail.tsx renders `{t('invoices.setAmount')} (${invoice.currency})` and the he.ts string for setAmount already carries the shekel sign.
repro: Sign in as owner → /invoices/f4000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000013 → דרישת זיכוי → read the amount field's label.
expected: One currency marker per field, and one that is right for a non-shekel invoice (a USD credit would read 'סכום (₪) (USD)').
actual: Two markers, and the hard-coded one is wrong for every currency but ILS.
